Use integrations
Install, discover, and use integration packages that add components, templates, themes, and docs to your app.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

discover-integrations   Discover integrations - Integration packages extend Astryx with extra components, templates,
                        themes, docs, and codemods. They are published as regular npm packages.
install-an-integration  Install an integration - Install the package with your package manager. Integrations autolink:
                        the CLI finds them among your dependencies, so installing is all it takes:
use-what-it-adds        Use what it adds - Once installed, the integration's contributions appear alongside Core:
check-for-problems      Check for problems - Run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 doctor` to see integration issues:
                        missing roots, invalid contributions, or a CLI version mismatch. The doctor check is the one
                        place every issue for every package is listed.

Read one section: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs use-integrations <section>
Read everything:  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs use-integrations --full
